title: Avatar generators for faceless narrators (DiceBear, Boring Avatars, Notion Avatar)
summary: Generate consistent SVG narrator avatars with DiceBear, Boring Avatars or Notion Avatar while respecting per-style licences.
description: Use when a faceless channel needs a consistent narrator or 'commenter' avatars without photos of real people. DiceBear (MIT code, per-style artwork licences), Boring Avatars (MIT, abstract), and Notion Avatar (MIT code, CC0 assets) generate SVG avatars deterministically. Warns about the NC xkcd font.

source.notes: Describes https://github.com/dicebear/dicebear (checked 2026-10-10); contains no third-party media.
